ProxyPiTester v1.3.1
====================

UK residential proxy test & app routing for ProxyPi.
https://proxypi.co.uk

If the app won't stay open
--------------------------
1. Extract the full zip to a folder (Desktop is fine) — do not run from inside the zip.
2. Right-click ProxyPiTester.exe → Properties → if you see Unblock, tick it → Apply → OK.
3. Windows Security may block unsigned apps: Allow on device / Run anyway.
4. If it still fails, open ProxyPiTester-startup.log next to the EXE and email support@proxypi.co.uk

Quick start
-----------
1. Double-click ProxyPiTester.exe
2. Log in with your ProxyPi account (optional: Remember me)
3. Login and Load My Proxy
4. Test Proxy / Speed Test
5. Open apps from Active Apps (keep this app open while routing)

Support: support@proxypi.co.uk
